cohort: The study included 42.32 million obstetric hospitalizations, comparing 31,439 women aged 18-50 years with Rheumatoid Arthritis to a general obstetric population without RA.
finding: Women with Rheumatoid Arthritis had a significantly higher prevalence of hypertensive diseases, premature rupture of membranes, antepartum hemorrhage, preterm delivery, intrauterine growth retardation, and cesarean delivery compared to the general obstetric population.
mod_finding: The maternal Rheumatoid Arthritis population had a significantly higher prevalence of cesarean delivery.
